faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Search or filter below to find instant answers about delivery, warranty replacements, payment methods (USDT / EasyPaisa / JazzCash), and account privacy.

items.q: How long does activation take? (Delivery time)
items.a: Most AI tool and software activations take between **5 to 30 minutes** after your payment confirmation. Client email activation tools (such as Gemini 1.5 Pro, Lovable Pro, or Google AI Ultra Family Invite) are activated directly on your email address immediately upon receiving your details on WhatsApp.

items.q: How does a warranty replacement work?
items.a: Every purchase comes with full duration warranty replacement protection. If you face any login or subscription issue during your warranty period, simply send a screenshot of the error to our WhatsApp support at [**+92 344 5739206**](https://wa.me/923445739206). Our support team will resolve or replace your account within **10 to 30 minutes**.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept? (Worldwide & Pakistan)
items.a:
We support all official payment methods:
• **Worldwide**: USDT via Binance (BEP20 & TRC20 networks), for fast, low-fee checkout from any country.
• **Pakistan**: EasyPaisa, JazzCash, Meezan Bank and all local bank transfers.

items.q: How can international customers pay with USDT?
items.a: When you place your order on WhatsApp, tell our support team you want to pay with **USDT (Binance)**. The team will confirm the exact USDT amount and share our official BEP20 / TRC20 wallet address.

items.q: What is the difference between "On client email" (private) and shared accounts?
items.a:
• **Private Accounts (ON CLIENT EMAIL)**: 100% private subscription setup directly on your personal Gmail/Email. Your data, code, prompts and files stay confidential and only in your account.
• **Shared Accounts**: A budget-friendly option where several buyers share one login. Every plan is clearly labelled so you can choose the right one.

items.q: What does your money-back refund policy cover?
items.a: Our refund policy is transparent and customer-first. If your subscription has a technical issue during the warranty period and we cannot fix or replace it, we issue a **pro-rata / money-back refund**.

items.q: Do I get a setup guide after ordering?
items.a: Yes. A step-by-step video or screenshot setup guide is sent with your order on WhatsApp, so you can start using your tool right away.

items.q: On how many devices can I use CapCut Pro?
items.a: CapCut Pro plans **2 devices (PC, Mobile, Tablet)** can stay logged in at the same time, with all Pro effects, 4K export, AI text-to-speech and full warranty support.

items.q: How does the Google AI Ultra (Veo 3, Antigravity, Flow) invitation work?
items.a: With the Google AI Ultra Family Invitation plan, an official Google invitation is sent to your email. Once you accept it, your own account gets 25K AI credits, Veo 3, Google Antigravity and Gemini Ultra features.

items.q: How do I apply a discount coupon?
items.a: Enter your code (e.g. `MDC10`) in the coupon box above the catalog. The discount is deducted from your cart total and added to your WhatsApp order message automatically.
